paragraphs: CASSIE is a computer management solution for public and academic libraries with Windows, macOS or Chrome OS computer labs. Features listed for it include time management, print management, statistics reporting, computer reservations and waiting lists, and visual management. The pages state that those features will reduce the amount of time staff spend on mundane tasks.

SPOT Global Print allows patrons to print from any Internet-connected device or computer, on the go or at home. SPOT Intelligent HotSpot is a patron device management solution that integrates with CASSIE. It offers print management along with staff monitoring and control functions.

quote.text: SPOT Global Print allows patrons to print to your printers from any Internet-connected device or computer, on-the-go or at home.
